about_the_game:
A Financial Quest Turned Adventure:

  • Play as a reckless adventurer who burned down a tavern—and now owes 1,000,000 gold.

  • Pay up… or fight your way to freedom.

  • Every step can lead to riches, danger, or absurd misfortune.

Choose Your Path:

  • Trade on a volatile coin market — buy low, sell high… or lose everything.

  • Fight through 50+ enemies and elite bosses.

  • Encounter hundreds of events — from lucky bags to mysterious figures in the woods.

Develop Your Hero:

  • Level up and allocate stat points: Strength, Intelligence, Luck, Defense.

  • Unlock weapons, potions, and powerful pets to aid your journey.

  • Progress, fail, adapt — every decision counts.

Combat & Core Gameplay:

  • Turn-based battles using normal attacks and unique abilities.

  • Use potions: Immortality, Stone Skin, Damage Boost, and more.

  • Each step can trigger a fight — or something far worse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core (или аналогичный)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 600 / AMD Radeon HD 7000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 8 / 7 / Vista / XP
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Quad Core 2.0 (or higher)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 and higher, ATI Radeon HD-Series 4650 and higher, Nvidia GeForce 2xx-Series and up
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Yes

short_description: You're in debt — and payback is coming. Turn-based combat, random events, and cunning enemies await at every step. Trade, grow stronger, fight — and decide for yourself: will you pay for your past mistakes, or fight for your freedom?
